purpose: Evaluate the frozen accuracy candidate on previously unused operator input, separately from physical tracking.
operator_sequence: Engage and hold a comfortable reachable pose for 3 seconds.
With hands comfortably in front of the torso, rotate each wrist in turn and hold each endpoint for 3 seconds.
Reach forward within a comfortable range and return twice; hold endpoints for 3 seconds. Do not force a straight-arm or joint-limit pose.
Move both arms together, then pinch, complete the return, re-engage and pinch again.

analysis_before_tuning.input: One new untouched operator JSONL; preserve original and SHA256 before analysis.
analysis_before_tuning.comparison: Replay identical processed targets and initial state through pre-change and frozen candidate IK. Do not overwrite either configuration or its historical artifacts.
metrics_each_arm: Position residual in mm: mean, median, p95 and max, separated into movement and stationary-target windows.
Orientation geodesic residual in degrees: mean, median, p95 and max, with the same windows.
Time to reach and continuously remain within 10 mm and 5 degrees for 0.5 seconds after each target hold; report not_reached rather than omitting failures.
Tracking/braking/return states, sampled clearance, joint range, velocity and acceleration violations.
analysis_before_tuning.stationary_window_rule: Use at least 2 seconds of target positions within 5 mm of the window start and target orientations within 2 degrees of the window start. Assess the final 1 second. If none qualify, stationary accuracy is unavailable.
analysis_before_tuning.offline_comparison_gate: For each arm, full tracking-window mean position and orientation errors must improve versus the pre-change profile. Each p95 must be no worse than baseline plus 0.05 mm or 0.05 degree. Preserve the existing range, speed, acceleration, clearance and cycle tests. This is a comparative software gate, not a physical safety criterion.
analysis_before_tuning.if_gate_fails: Retain the failure and label the candidate as failing this new episode. If tuning uses this episode, it becomes development data; reserve a further new episode for validation.

physical_evidence.required_for_motor_tracking_claims: Final command-observer CSV plus LowState with documented timestamps and joint ordering.
separate_stages: operator target to IK command FK
IK input to final writer command
final writer command to measured joints
physical_evidence.clock_rule: Do not equate clocks or add errors from different windows. Without justified alignment, report per-stream measurements only.
physical_evidence.acceptance_rule: A successful write or UDP send does not prove motor acceptance.
physical_evidence.unavailable_data: Quest-only input supports IK comparison, not actual G1 response or PD optimization.

execution: No robot or Unity process is started by this document. Use the existing supported operator workflow only when equipment is available.
